question.text:
Which of the following set is having correct statements for enzyme catalysis?
1. Each enzyme is specific for a given reaction
2. The enzyme activity is maximum at optimum pH
3. The enzymatic activity is increased in presence of certain substances called  co-enzymes
4. The favourable temperature range of enzyme activity is between 50-60 °C

solution.text: Here statement 1, 2 and 3 are correct and 4 one is incorrect as the favourable temperature range for enzymatic activity is <math><mn>25</mn><mo>-</mo><mn>37</mn><mo>°</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></math> . enzymatic activity is destroyed at about <math><mn>70</mn><mo>°</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></math> .
